character: Wolf Heimlich and Detective O'Riley after Ernie's murder
voice: Wolf is suspicious, severe, and disciplined; O'Riley remains patronizing without stage-Irish spelling.

entries.text: So. You have finally come to confess.
Confess? No, I'm reporting a murder!
And once again, you were the first to find the body?
A remarkable coincidence. You will come to my office and answer questions. I have had enough of your evasions.
Calm down, Heimlich. If there's any questioning to be done, I'll be the one doing it.
Where did you find the body, Miss Bow?
The Mastodon room. He's hanging from some Mastodon tusks.
He is probably sleeping at his post.
I'll have a look. If I need to question you, I'll find you later.
You smell like a brewery, Detective. Either you have been drinking, or those grapes have finally fermented.
A man needs a pull from his flask now and then, doesn't he?
I require no alcohol. It impairs both judgment and reflexes.
